metadata.description: Mizan agent skills — package Mizan's evaluation, authoring, and results workflows as model-invoked skills that drive the mizan CLI over -o json.

plugins.name: mizan-eval
plugins.description: Run a single or pairwise Mizan evaluation against a metric template and explain the verdict.

plugins.name: mizan-results
plugins.description: Turn stored Mizan eval results into a single self-contained, standalone HTML report (summary, score distribution, per-metric trend) from `results list -o json`, and triage a single past run (provenance, verdict explanation, next steps) from `results show`/`results list -o json`.

plugins.name: mizan-setup
plugins.description: Configure Mizan for first use: inspect the resolved configuration via `config show -o json`, persist project/location/default-model/results-store settings with `config set`, confirm the build with `version`, and check (never store) Application Default Credentials.

plugins.name: mizan-authoring
plugins.description: Author, validate (creds-free), and share Mizan metric-template packs: scaffold a pack, create templates via the mizan CLI, run `pack validate` (the CI PR gate), and the export->PR->import collaborator loop; plus generate a rubric from a brand book (suggest-first, agent-side synthesis) and freeze it into the registry.
